question: Which of the following lakes is the longest in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vembanad Lake.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vembanad Lake** is the** longest lake** in India, with a length of about **96.5 km.**
 
• It is located in the state of **Kerala** and is the largest **brackish water** lake in India.
 
• The lake is fed by several rivers, including the **Periyar, Muvattupuzha, and Pamba.**
 
• The lake is an important tourist destination and supports a variety of **aquatic life, including fish, crabs, and shrimp.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanjia Lake:**

 
 
• It is a **freshwater lake located in Odisha** and is known for its rich biodiversity, including several species of **migratory birds.**
 
• The wetland's entire area, including the **diving facilities, **is **105 hectares.**
 
 
 
• **Ansupa Lake**:
 
 
• It is a** freshwater lake** l**ocated in Odisha **and is known for its scenic beauty and as a popular picnic spot.
 
• Ansupa Lake is a** 231-hectare freshwater oxbow lake **with a horseshoe form that is located in the Cuttack district across from **Banki** on the left bank of the **Mahanadi River.**
 
 
 
• **Wular Lake: **
 
 
• **​**It is a freshwater lake located in **Jammu and Kashmir **and is the largest natural freshwater lake in India.
 
• It is fed by the Jhelum River and is an important **source of fish** for the local population.
